d:
Idu Raama Mandira Is A Beautiful Evergreen Audio Song From The Classic Kannada Movie Ravi Chandra, Featuring Dr. Rajkumar And Lakshmi. Music Composed By Upendra Kumar. Enjoy This Timeless Kannada Melody And Relive The Golden Era Of Kannada Cinema With This Nostalgic Old Hit Song.
Directed by: A. V. Sheshagiri Rao
Produced by: Parvathamma Rajkumar
Written by: Shankar - Sundar
Artist Name: Dr. Rajkumar, Lakshmi
Music Director: Upendra Kumar
Cinematography: Annayya, Mallik
Banner: Poornima Enterprises
